bundle.shortDescription: A Wisp-inspired system monitor and task manager
bundle.longDescription: Tasma is a fast, focused system monitor and task manager for Windows: live CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU telemetry plus a full process workbench (end task, suspend, priority, efficiency mode).
